water_note.structure: No permanent natural lakes or perennial rivers. ~90% of demand met by desalination (35 plants); remainder from depleting fossil aquifers (Saq/Saq-Ram). Surface water only in ephemeral wadis after storms.
water_note.game_effect: Water is a build-site dependency, not a map feature. Desalination plants are coastal single points of failure.
